requirement: HV components shall have voltage rating with approved transient margin above 850 V.
The precharge resistor shall withstand initial pulse power and absorbed energy for defined repetitions.
acceptance: Peak pulse and energy remain within supplier SOA

requirement: Effective DC-link capacitance shall include tolerance, bias, ageing and temperature.
acceptance: Worst-case capacitance used in timing verification

requirement: Each contactor driver shall support command readback and auxiliary-contact feedback.
acceptance: Open, short and welded conditions diagnosable

requirement: The discharge network shall meet touch-safe timing at maximum R and C tolerance.
Pack and DC-link voltage channels shall support independent plausibility or redundant comparison.
acceptance: Single-channel bias cannot cause unsafe main closure

requirement: HVIL input shall detect open circuit and out-of-range conditions.
acceptance: All defined faults detected within FTTI

requirement: Control-to-HV measurement isolation shall satisfy the product insulation coordination plan.
acceptance: Creepage, clearance and dielectric withstand pass

requirement: The precharge path shall provide current observation or an equivalent validated voltage-response estimator.
acceptance: Precharge short producing >15 A or excessive dV/dt is detected within 20 ms
